title: A 2-month social item is glancing at the caregiver's face
summary: CDC says that by about 2 months most babies look at a caregiver's face.
body: The social list for 2 months includes looking at your face. Neighboring lines mention calming when spoken to or picked up, and smiling when you talk or smile; this card is only the look. The page's most means 75 percent or more. A glance does not forecast later friendship. The program says its sheets are not a screening instrument, and agencies outside the United States may print another age.
